input.quote: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES.
input.rationale: A mutual cap and a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages exist (p0035, p0036), so the structure is not one-sided against us. However, the cap fails the fallback on carve-outs: the only exception is "CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9", and Paragraph 9 is "INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR" — there is no indemnification clause anywhere in the agreement (the sole hit for "indemnif" is the Section 7 heading), so the carve-out is inoperative. Nothing is carved out for confidentiality (Section 8), gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud or IP infringement (the Section 5(c) non-infringement warranty is fully capped). The fallback requires carve-outs at least for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct, so this is a material failure. The basis is also weaker than preferred: fees "PAID" (not paid or payable) for the individual Statement of Work, which can fall well below twelve months' fees, with no USD floor. We left Company's cap untouched because it limits our exposure and benefits us. Redline sets Contractor's cap at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, defines Excluded Claims as uncapped, and confirms our fee-payment obligation is not "damages".

ops.oldText: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES.
ops.newText: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO EXCLUDED CLAIMS, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE GREATER OF (A) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE TO CONTRACTOR UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS; COMPANY'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO ANY CAP IN THIS PARAGRAPH.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We tied Contractor's cap to the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000 and replaced the cross-reference to Paragraph 9 (independent contractor status) with a defined set of Excluded Claims, so that confidentiality, data protection, indemnity, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap. Our position is a meaningful cap with these standard carve-outs; we can accept a straight twelve months' fees cap as a fallback if the USD floor is an issue.
proposal.summary: Set Contractor's cap at greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1m and add standard uncapped carve-outs (Excluded Claims).
